designPhilosophy: Ratcheting 0°–85° tilt mast + quick-lock canvas clamp jaws + 2020 aluminum extrusion spine + knurled M5 brass knobs
summary: Commercial beechwood and anodized studio tabletop easels cost $165–$215 for basic tilt hinges and sliding canvas blocks. This DIY alternative combines 6 rigid PETG/PLA+ printed brackets and ratcheting quadrants with a $7.90 2020 V-slot aluminum extrusion spine and McMaster-Carr M5 brass knurled thumb hardware for $27.40 total.
assemblyNotes: Print PRT-01 (Base Hub), PRT-02 (Ratchet Hinge), and PRT-04 (Upper Clamp Jaw) in PETG with 4 perimeter walls and 35% gyroid infill for high clamping stiffness.
All T-slot sliding rails include a 0.25mm lateral clearance so carriages glide smoothly along the 2020 aluminum profile without binding.
All 6 printed STL parts (8 total items including ×3 knobs) pack onto 1 single 256×256mm Bambu Lab A1 build plate with zero support material.

parts.name: Weighted H-Frame Studio Base Hub
parts.description: Wide-stance H-frame base block with recessed EPDM foot pockets and dual hinge clevis ears.
parts.roleInAssembly: Anchors the easel to the tabletop and houses the lower tilt hinge pivot.

parts.name: 15°-Step Ratcheting Tilt Mast Hinge
parts.description: Toothed quadrant hinge socket that grips the bottom of the 2020 aluminum mast and locks tilt angle.
parts.roleInAssembly: Couples the 2020 aluminum spine to the base hub with positive angular indexing.

parts.name: Lower Canvas Ledge & Brush Rest Tray
parts.description: Full-width lower support shelf with integrated brush groove and 2020 V-slot tongue.
parts.roleInAssembly: Supports the bottom edge of the canvas and slides vertically on the 2020 mast.

parts.name: Sliding Top Canvas Clamp Jaw
parts.description: Inverted L-jaw carriage that clamps the top stretcher bar of the canvas without marring paint.
parts.roleInAssembly: Locks top canvas edge against the 2020 mast via an M5 T-nut.

parts.name: 2020 V-Slot Rear Strut Locking Collar
parts.description: Sliding rear collar that braces the mast tilt quadrant against brush pressure.
parts.roleInAssembly: Reinforces mast inclination angle on the rear V-slot channel.

parts.name: Lobed M5 Brass-Insert Rosette Knobs (×3)
parts.description: Six-lobe ergonomic hand knobs with hex pockets for M5 brass thumb nuts.
parts.roleInAssembly: Provides tool-free locking for the tilt hinge, lower tray, and top canvas clamp.

parts.name: 2020 Black Anodized V-Slot Aluminum Extrusion (400mm)
parts.description: Precision 20×20mm V-slot linear aluminum profile acting as the rigid vertical spine.
parts.roleInAssembly: Primary vertical mast along which the lower tray and top canvas clamp travel.

parts.name: M5×0.8mm Solid Brass Knurled Thumb Nuts & Inserts (10-Pack)
parts.description: Precision diamond-knurled solid brass M5 thumb nuts and heat-set threaded inserts.
parts.roleInAssembly: Press-fits into PRT-06 knobs and PRT-02 hinge for smooth, wear-free clamping threads.

parts.name: M5×20mm Stainless Socket Cap Screws & 2020 Roll-In T-Nuts
parts.description: Roll-in ball-spring M5 T-nuts for 2020 extrusion paired with M5×20mm & M5×35mm socket screws.
parts.roleInAssembly: Captures the lower canvas tray, upper clamp jaw, and rear collar inside the 2020 slot.

parts.name: Non-Slip EPDM Rubber Foot Pads & Canvas Jaw Cushions (8-Pack)
parts.description: High-friction adhesive rubber bumper pads for the H-frame base and canvas clamp jaws.
parts.roleInAssembly: Prevents tabletop skidding under brush strokes and cushions canvas stretcher bars.

parts.name: 302 Stainless Compression Detent Spring (8mm OD × 25mm)
parts.description: Precision ground-end compression spring that preloads the ratcheting tilt hinge teeth.
parts.roleInAssembly: Keeps the 15°-step ratchet hinge engaged while adjusting mast angle.
